resources.string: Inspect sample screen states. These previews do not save or advance.

Explore, lotteries, reservations, Inbox and admin use connected sample records. Search, guest matching and reservation categories use fixed preview outcomes. Name/contact validation and other reserved helpers remain pending. Profile photos and Inbox read marks change locally; reset restores the sample records. Booking, payments, lottery changes and campsite saves require the Firebase build.
Lists retain the sample order; production ordering helpers remain pending.
